name: deepwiki-pinned-researcher
description: High-continuity documentation search tool. Eliminates 3,400 tokens of raw MCP schema bloat by routing queries through a pinned, zero-drift Bazantic recipe.

topic.description: The technology, framework, or library to look up (e.g., 'playwright', 'base-chain', 'cloudflare-workers').

query.description: The specific question, error code, or architectural component needed.

input_example.query: capturing element screenshot with sticky header hidden

output_example.summary: To prevent sticky navigation elements from overlapping element screenshots in Playwright, hide the masthead prior to capture via page.evaluate(() => document.querySelector('.masthead').style.display = 'none'), or scroll with scroll-margin-top offset.

prompt_template: Using the bound gateway tool 'getLatestGrade' on the clembot-doorman gateway (call ONLY 'getLatestGrade', do NOT call getBadge or getFeed), inspect the trust grade and pinned usage recipe for DeepWiki ('https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp'). Confirm the server is graded A with zero hard fails. Then, format and execute a targeted documentation lookup for {{inputs}} using the pinned parameters. Extract only the precise syntax, code example, and explanation. Return a compact, verified answer matching output_example.
